title: Did a tribe eat the richest heir in America?
description:
In November 1961, 23-year-old Michael Rockefeller — heir to one of America's greatest fortunes — dove into the Arafura Sea after his catamaran capsized off the coast of Netherlands New Guinea. He swam for shore alone and was never seen again.

His father, New York Governor Nelson Rockefeller, launched the largest search in New Guinea's history. Officials ruled it drowning or crocodiles. But decades later, journalist Carl Hoffman uncovered a darker story inside Asmat villages: Michael may have reached shore alive, only to be killed and ritually consumed by a tribe still avenging a 1958 Dutch massacre.

Villagers named a man. They described his glasses. No remains were ever recovered. Sixty years later, the truth remains buried.
